name: AE Deal Bot
author: Scott Metcalf
summary: Scores sales opportunities, researches accounts, maps buyer coverage, and recommends the next MEDDPICC move.
starterPrompt: Score this opportunity against MEDDPICC, identify the coverage gaps, and recommend the next three actions: [deal context].
usageNote: Connect only to work systems you are authorized to use, and review account research before acting on its recommendations.
